# Embedding Model Comparison

**Status:** REVIEWED — benchmark run 2026-07-01 (2-model subset; bge-m3 pending)
**Owner:** Research Agent
**Qdrant:** `research_lab_*` collections on port **6334** only
**Artifact:** `docs/research/artifacts/embedding_benchmark_latest.json` (generated by `embedding_eval.py`)

## Hypothesis

Upgrading from `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` (384-dim, production default) to a larger sentence embedding model will improve file-level recall@10 on the VECTORDB-BRAIN micro-corpus without unacceptable latency or re-index cost at current scale.

## Method

1. **Corpus:** `data/sources/` sample files (`sample-rag.md`, `sample-note.md`, `sample-ops.txt`).
2. **Chunking:** `recursive_char_v1`, size 450, overlap 60 (matches `omnikb` settings).
3. **Queries:** Five hand-authored queries in `docs/research/benchmarks/fixtures/queries.json`, each labeled with an expected `source_file`.
4. **Metric — recall@k:** For each query, success if any chunk from the labeled source appears in the top-k results (cosine, normalized embeddings).
5. **Latency:** p50/p95 per-query `query_points` round-trip on research Qdrant.
6. **Index build:** embed all chunks + create collection + upsert (ms).
7. **Memory:** optional RSS delta via `psutil` when available on the runner host.
8. **Composite score** (higher is better), weights:
   - recall@10: **0.45**
   - recall@5: **0.15**
   - latency (inverse-normalized p50): **0.25**
   - memory (inverse-normalized RSS delta): **0.10**
   - index build (inverse-normalized): **0.05**

**Run commands (Podman on Windows — confirmed working 2026-07-01):**

```powershell
# 1. Shared network so containers can resolve each other by name
podman network create research-net   # idempotent; ignore "already exists"

# 2. Research Qdrant on the network (internal port 6333; no host binding needed)
podman run -d --name qdrant-research --network research-net `
  -v qdrant_research_data:/qdrant/storage qdrant/qdrant:latest

# 3. Run benchmark (2-model subset; drop -e line for all 3 models)
podman run --rm --network research-net `
  -v "I:/VECTORDB-BRAIN:/app" -w /app `
  -e PYTHONPATH=/app/src `
  -e QDRANT_URL=http://qdrant-research:6333 `
  -e RESEARCH_BENCHMARK_MODELS=all-MiniLM-L6-v2,all-mpnet-base-v2 `
  localhost/vectordb-brain-api:latest `
  python docs/research/benchmarks/embedding_eval.py
```

> **Runner note:** Host Windows Python fails to import `sentence_transformers` (torchcodec). Use the `vectordb-brain-api` Podman image. `host.containers.internal` does NOT reach a loopback-bound Qdrant; use the shared-network approach above.

## Results

*Run 2026-07-01 — 2-model subset, micro-corpus (3 chunks / 3 sample files, 5 queries). Artifact: `docs/research/artifacts/embedding_benchmark_latest.json`.*

| Model | dims | recall@5 | recall@10 | lat p50 (ms) | lat p95 (ms) | index build (ms) | mem Δ (MB) | Score | Notes |
|-------|------|----------|----------|-------------|-------------|-----------------|-----------|-------|-------|
| all-mpnet-base-v2 | 768 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 43.5 | 48.4 | 28 511 | 365 | 0.95 | Faster query; slower build; lower RSS |
| all-MiniLM-L6-v2 *(prod)* | 384 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 47.3 | 59.9 | 20 392 | 459 | 0.65 | Current production default |
| bge-m3 | 1024 | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | *(pending — requires longer download run)* |

> ⚠️ **Corpus caveat:** Only 3 chunks exist in the sample corpus. All models saturate at 100% recall trivially. Composite score gap (0.95 vs 0.65) is driven purely by latency/memory normalization, not recall differentiation. Results are **not** sufficient to decide an upgrade. Re-run required on N≥50 curated documents.

Qualitative trade-offs:

| Model | Dim | Expected recall | Expected latency | Re-index cost |
|-------|-----|-----------------|------------------|---------------|
| all-MiniLM-L6-v2 | 384 | Baseline | Lowest | Current production |
| all-mpnet-base-v2 | 768 | Higher on short text | ~1.5–2× encode | Full re-embed |
| bge-m3 | 1024 | Best multilingual/dense | Heaviest | Full re-embed + RAM |

| Model | Dim | Expected recall | Expected latency | Re-index cost |
|-------|-----|-----------------|------------------|---------------|
| all-MiniLM-L6-v2 | 384 | Baseline | Lowest | Current production |
| all-mpnet-base-v2 | 768 | Higher on short text | ~1.5–2× encode | Full re-embed |
| bge-m3 | 1024 | Best multilingual/dense | Heaviest | Full re-embed + RAM |

## Recommendation

**Confirmed 2026-07-01:** Keep **`all-MiniLM-L6-v2`** for Layer 1 production. The 2-model micro-corpus run saturated at 100% recall for both models — the upgrade gate (≥0.2 absolute recall gain) **cannot be evaluated** at 3-chunk scale. No evidence yet to justify a full re-embed (2× storage, 2× index size, breaking change to all Qdrant point IDs).

**Decision gate for upgrade:** If benchmark shows **recall@10 ≥ 0.2 absolute gain** on the pilot queries *and* p95 latency stays **< 250 ms** on research hardware, schedule a one-time re-embed behind a feature flag (`EMBEDDING_MODEL` + new Qdrant collection name). Prefer **`all-mpnet-base-v2`** over `bge-m3` unless multilingual retrieval is a near-term requirement.

**Human decision (Orchestrator):** Confirm upgrade before any change to `omnikb` default or production collection — see `AGENT_WORK_LOG.md` item 3.
